objective: Admit the minimum lawful source set for the European procurement universe through independent rights, privacy, quality, attribution and revocation gates.
outcome: TED Search API v3 is registered for a non-personal technical probe with documented commercial-reuse basis, conditional rights dimensions, privacy exclusions, successful live access and an enabled kill switch; PRODUCT_ADMITTED remains blocked.

skills.activation_reason: Own TED rights, access, attribution, quality and revocation decisions.
Control natural-person and professional contact fields present in notices.
Review endpoint allowlisting, response budgets, redirects and kill switches.
Define subtype, country, field and lineage quality gates.
Prevent technical access from being equated with product admission.

external: TED legal notice and privacy statement
TED Search API and Open Data reuse documentation

prohibited_scope: PRODUCT_ADMITTED state before complete gate evidence
Customer display, export or API redistribution

acceptance_evidence.description: Typed source record separates permitted, conditional and unknown reuse dimensions.
Source review documents API, JSON/XML roles, rights, privacy, limitations and promotion gates.
Official endpoint returned a bounded non-personal projection: three notices, totalNoticeCount 2023, zero missing requested fields and no persisted notice values.
Endpoint allowlist, redirects, response-size limit and personal-field exclusion pass.
Country and notice-subtype completeness, version lineage and winner coverage meet declared thresholds.

traces: official XML retrieval after future admission
alerts: source state escalated without required evidence

rollback.strategy: Set source to RESTRICTED or REVOKED, disable the connector, preserve non-sensitive evidence and re-evaluate dependent claims before any future product admission.
rollback.kill_switch: src_ted_search_api_v3 kill switch remains enabled and runtime integration remains absent.

goal_lock_checks.evidence: The source is official primary evidence for procurement discovery.
Raw response hashes and future XML lineage are mandatory.
TED provides geography, organisations and lifecycle fields for all three lenses.
User demand cannot alter source facts or admission state.
Official languages and source-language preservation are part of the access contract.
Primary-source history and lineage strengthen differentiation from general AI.
The source is used for observation, not advice or bid execution.
Rights and personal-data dimensions are explicit and fail closed.
The source has an independent kill switch and no runtime dependency yet.
The technical probe advances the minimum-source admission gate without overstating it.
